messages:
Eli: wildly off-topic but has anyone's modem started blinking orange for no reason at midnight? Mine did and I half expected a ghost. :ghost: 
Rowan: same here, this week my router reboots at 00:00 like clockwork. ISP says "no issues". :man-shrugging: 
Cam: check your scheduled tasks on the router web UI. Mine had an automatic reboot scheduled for firmware check. Took it off and problem solved.
Eli: oh wow, didn't know routers did that. where's the setting?
Cam: usually under System -> Schedule or Maintenance. if sshable: `uci show system.@cron` on OpenWrt.
InfraBot: FYI: maintenance window for colo-2 is tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC for UPS firmware updates. Expect short BMC reboots.
Rowan: thanks @InfraBot. good reminder to avoid long builds then.
Eli: turned off scheduled reboot and now crossing fingers. also placed a sticky note on my modem: "dont reboot after tacos".
Cam: pro tip: label your cables and your routers. made life 10x easier when I moved apartments.
Rowan: vote: best cable label method? 1) printed labels 2) colored zip ties 3) masking tape + sharpie. react 1/2/3.
Cam: 2 for me. looks neat and fast.
Eli: 3. cheap and replaceable.
Rowan: tie vote resolved by random: masking tape it is.
Cam: midnight modem mystery narrowly averted.
